summary: Davao Oriental 2nd District representative with 112 principal-authored bills. Reviewed bills combine anti-hunger and cash-assistance programs with small-business and estate-tax relief.
caveat: Individual income tax restructuring bill (HB10720) could not be scored because its direction was not shown; no non-economic evidence found.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Principal author of 4Ps amendment, food-stamp (REFUEL) and AICS bills (left) alongside MCIT exemption for micro and small firms and estate-tax amnesty extension (market-leaning). Net slightly left. Bills only.
